DB_owner.semantic: Exact original first matching pUnused entry with flags & 3, detached without changing inode references/locks. A failed-unlock counter witness becomes token-free and is retired at last reference.

command10.pathname: private already-issued nonempty main-database pathname without embedded NUL; no normalization, no symbolic-link prohibition
command10.read_only_source: fixed carrier copies the complete original command into its private readonly lease before the HIA entry; same source remains immutable across GROW and child continuations

order: If the current native process-global inode directory is empty, complete miss without a filesystem or DB action.
Otherwise invoke the same DMS-owned shared FS session for one actual op18 path STAT, preserving normal symlink following.
A known STAT failure or unmatched device/inode is a miss; accept the actual FS call/syscall watermark and do not create a DB context.
For the selected existing node, issue DB reuse-r3 command9 from the native outer with the same full flags and issued action lease.
Validate actual role/node/generation/source/return/workspace, unchanged references and lock counters.
For a nonzero returned token, consume the matching deferred outer file record; a DB ghost must have no token and no pUnused link.
Publish the complete actual DB result, with no close, open, lock, retry or additional registration FSTAT.

selected_inode.body: Exact actual HIANDB01 completed result. Word10 is detached FS token or0; the original DB result and counters are unmasked.

result.next_owner: Only the same fixed native context may use the transferred token. It may subsequently register that token as a fresh outer/DB handle; old file and DB handle IDs are not revived.

private_memory_and_identity.source_growth: The original outer source blob and pending child blob are retained over GROW; no child is re-entered solely to grow the outer output.
private_memory_and_identity.registry_compaction: Reacquire the selected node by the immutable actual stat key after reserve may compact records.
private_memory_and_identity.node_counters: TAKE_UNUSED does not change nRef,nShared,nLock,eFileLock or bProcessLock.
private_memory_and_identity.authority: Request/result bytes, counters and nonces do not authenticate external callers. Only fixed-carrier-issued private context/source/result leases are accepted.

explicit_open_scope: The broader original C helper can be called privately with an empty C pathname; FS op18 currently admits only nonempty paths. Empty-path STAT is not implemented by this revision and must be joined with the full FS7/unixOpen pathname layer; no public compatibility closure is claimed.
Complete unixOpen entry (PID/malloc/temp/URI/root selection), create mode/robust open/read-only fallback and post-fill warning probes remain separate unfinished integration.
Ordinary AgentStore, all31 relational operations, physical transaction/log/migration and multiwriter installation remain OPEN.
